R187.note: Separator-boundary prefix check correctly excludes sibling dirs like uploads-backup while allowing the base dir itself; no other behavior change.

R188.note: Named-placeholder bindparams/execute-with-dict both correctly parameterize date_filter; query semantics unchanged.

R189.note: strnlen(name, sizeof(name)) closes the overread, preserves length for NUL-terminated names, never touches flags; unterminated 16-byte names return 16 rather than an explicit error, but that is a faithful bounded length, not an OOB read or silent behavior change.

R190.note: Moves param into filterArgs as {1} while street stays {0}; JNDI resolves {i} by array index regardless of position in the string, so escaping is correctly applied to both values.

R191.note: random_bytes(16)/bin2hex replaces seeded mt_rand with a CSPRNG token; format change (hex vs numeric) is the point of the fix and is stated.

R192.note: Primary fix (check index >= segment.size()) matches the contract exactly, but the write-up also offers an 'alternative' that ANDs in the old claimedCapacity check, silently reintroducing the exact caller/span disagreement the contract says callers should no longer need to satisfy.

R193.note: Adds PasswordEncoder.matches() verification plus a dummy-hash timing-attack mitigation on user-not-found; constructor signature change is disclosed as a required follow-up.

R194.note: Query builder ->where() and DB::select() with ? placeholder both correctly parameterize region; result set and columns unchanged.

R195.note: PreparedStatement with setString(1, param) correctly parameterizes the injected value, same INSERT shape preserved; relies on an unverified DatabaseHelper.getConnection() helper not shown in the case file, a minor risk outside the reviewed file.

R196.note: Verified by compiling against commons-jexl3 3.7.0: JexlSandbox lives in org.apache.commons.jexl3.introspection, not org.apache.commons.jexl3 as imported, so the fix as written fails to compile (javac: cannot find symbol JexlSandbox); the broken build is not disclosed.

R197.note: @PreAuthorize + ownership-scoped query is the right pattern, but OrderSecurity calls orderRepository.findByIdAndOwner(...) while Order's actual field is customerUsername (not owner), so Spring Data's derived-query resolution throws PropertyReferenceException at context startup, breaking the whole application; not disclosed.

R198.note: escape-html applied to every interpolated value (id, subject, status, note) closes the reflected XSS; output is HTML-entity-encoded as expected, no functional change to legitimate content.

R199.note: Allowlisting only the 'status' field as a typeof-checked string blocks $-operator injection while keeping the documented extra-criteria use case and the mandatory ownerId check intact.

R200.note: Switches to Tika content-based detection with a fixed extension map and randomized filename, closing the extension-spoofing vector; image re-encoding and the changed stored-name format (now includes extension) are called out explicitly.

R201.note: Adds frameBuffer.size() < payloadLength bounds check before memcpy and returns false, fully using the bool return the function already declared; no other observable change.

R202.note: Removing the custom SignatureValidator restores the default JwtBearer signature/issuer/audience/lifetime validation pipeline; diff is minimal and Authority-based key resolution still applies.
